resources.string: Tandem follows these settings of your Tandoor account. They are changed on the Tandoor web, in your settings for the shopping list and the meal plan.

When this is on, checking off an item marks its food “at home” for the whole household. “Add to shopping list” and “Shop for the week” then start those foods unticked until the mark is removed in Tandoor.
Leave out what is at home
When Tandoor itself puts a recipe on the list, it leaves out foods marked “at home”. Tandem always starts them unticked and lets you choose.
Planned recipes go on the list
When this is on, “Add to the shopping list” is ticked from the start when you plan a meal with a recipe.
Updates while the list is open
Off: automatic sync is switched off in Tandoor
Changes by others show up at this pace. It follows your automatic sync setting in Tandoor and the server’s shortest interval.
